prompt:
EDIT the referenced cow image. Essential anatomical correction ONLY: turn EACH OF THE FOUR CLOVEN HOOVES around 180 DEGREES on its ankle. All four sharp cloven TOE TIPS point BACKWARD toward the cow's TAIL, opposite head direction. Viewer sees the blunt rounded HEELS at front of nearest hoof; cloven split and toe tips are visible on REAR side pointing away. Keep knee joints normal, only hooves reversed. Change camera to side-three-quarter if necessary so one near hoof in full side profile makes reverse orientation absolutely readable. No ordinary forward cow hooves. Exactly four legs, two toes each hoof. Preserve milk overflowing vessel and mountain forge. Source c07 explicitly backward hooves. Original specification: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Glas Gaibhnenn, fabulous Irish cow with reversed hooves and unfailing milk.
ANATOMY: ONE living bovine COW, one head, TWO eyes, FOUR legs with cloven hooves, one tail, a natural udder. Every hoof points BACKWARD relative to direction of body and head [glas-gaibhnenn-c07]. Show all FOUR legs and clear reversed hoof orientation, not broken legs. Grey mottled coat editorial; no invented extra horns, eyes, wings or magical markings.
MOMENT: Stride forcefully toward camera along wet mountain track, forelegs stepping through own strange backward-pointing tracks. Close reverse-hoof detail at bottom; strong cow face dominates top. A plain wide vessel beside rear udder physically overflows with pouring white milk, broad continuous spill across ground; no milker, no infant, no calf.
POWER: Unfailing profuse milk fills any vessel [glas-gaibhnenn-c01,glas-gaibhnenn-c08]; backward hooves confuse thieves through backward tracks [glas-gaibhnenn-c07]. White liquid is MILK, not light, no floating milk magic.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; side-three-quarter full-body cow fills square, hoofs large and individually traceable, avoid ordinary grazing cow; low close scale without giant body.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant amber fire or low moon, deep walnut shadows, hard rim light; ordinary dust, rain or spray as appropriate.
SURFACE: tactile natural hair, coarse cloth, wet scales, skin, wood or stone; premium painterly brushwork, no plastic.
SETTING: Mountain pasture near a smith forge, Sliabh-na-Glaise [glas-gaibhnenn-c05].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Helpful and living sacred figures remain benevolent, dignified and awe-inspiring.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.

The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px + 200px + four separate hoof crops and a mud-track crop. One living cow: one head, two eyes, one tail, a natural udder and exactly four legs (glas-gaibhnenn-c01). Reversed hooves verified on every visible hoof — the broad rounded heel faces the camera/head-direction while the sharp cloven toe-tips trail BACKWARD toward the tail (glas-gaibhnenn-c07), the opposite of the rejected toes-forward attempt-01; backward-pointing tracks lead across the foreground mud. White MILK physically pours from the udder into a plain wide vessel and overflows into a continuous stream across the ground (glas-gaibhnenn-c01/c08) — liquid milk, not glowing magic. Mountain pasture with a smith's forge, anvil and fire under a low moon (glas-gaibhnenn-c05). Dynamic low striding moment, a mythic distinction over an ordinary dairy cow; no extra horns/eyes/wings, no aura or text.
